verses: I also saw the souls of women who ever lacerated their own breasts with their own hands and teeth; and dogs ever tore and ate their bellies; and both feet stood on hot brass.
And I asked thus: 'Whose souls are these? and what sin was committed by them?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'These are the souls of those wicked women who, in the world, prepared food during menstruation, and brought it before a pious man, and bade him eat. They also ever resorted to sorcery; and they injured the earth of Spandarmad and the pious man.'
